blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The passage of a bill that seeks to strengthen the Safe Spaces Act shows the House of Representatives’ commitment to fighting violence against women and children (VAWC), Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III said on Wednesday. In a statement, Dy called for collective action against VAWC, as the House opened an exhibit for the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women. Aside from the passage of House Bill (HB) No. 11264, Dy said that the House would consider recommendations for a nationwide review of the Anti-VAWC Law to check on gaps in policy and enforcement. “I vow to […]...
